author: NorthernNick
quote:
It has bugs and is very unpolished at 30FPS. The storytelling and dialogue are stale, the characters are completely unfunny, and, dare I say, the whole game is “woke”. Where the previous games in this franchise have you basically unlimited freedom, this game prevents you from doing grand theft in your own neighborhood. You know, the thing the title says. 

This is much closer to a Sims game than a GTA game.

Never again will I buy a Rockstar game. Can’t wait to see Rockstar ruins the red dead redemption franchise!
